# NFSU2 Save Editor

> Free browser-based save editor for Need for Speed: Underground 2 (PC career saves, 54,966-byte "20CM" files, nfsu2.xyz .zip backups and GARAGE.DAT slots 6–10). Files are edited locally in the browser and never uploaded.

What it can do: set career cash and driver name; unlock and manage the five career garage slots; put story, rival or stock cars into any slot; move cars between slots 1–5 and GARAGE.DAT slots 6–10; set performance level, all 9 Outrun Unique parts and dyno presets per car; unlock vinyls & decals, body parts or specialties tables; complete the career (100 %, stage 6) while keeping your own cars; undo any change; see the real game-completion percentage. Checksums and the GARAGE.DAT fingerprint are recalculated on download.

## Editor

- [NFSU2 Save Editor](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/): load a save, .zip backup or GARAGE.DAT, edit, then download

## Guides

- [All NFSU2 guides](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/): index of the step-by-step guides
- [Save file location](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-save-file-location/): where NFSU2 keeps career saves on Windows and how to export/restore nfsu2.xyz backups
- [Money trainer](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-money-trainer/): set any career cash amount without memory trainers
- [Rachel's 350Z and boss cars](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/rachel-350z-nfsu2/): drive story and sponsor cars in career mode
- [Outrun Unique parts](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-outrun-unique-parts/): install all 9 unique performance upgrades per car
- [GARAGE.DAT slots 6–10](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-garage-dat-editor/): edit the extended garage used by nfsu2.xyz
- [PC cheat codes](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-cheat-codes-pc/): title-screen codes for cash and unlocks
- [100% save](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-100-percent-save/): finish the career on your own save and keep your cars
- [Save not loading or corrupted](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-save-not-loading-fix/): missing profile, damaged save, GARAGE.OLD and lost slots 6–10
- [Unlock all cars](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-unlock-all-cars/): how dealer cars unlock and how to put any car in your garage
- [Hidden shops](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-hidden-shops/): when the 22 shops open and how to reveal them
- [Career stages and completion %](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-career-stages-completion/): events, photos and shops per stage and how 100% is counted
- [Unlock vinyls, body kits and specialties](https://nfsu2.divon.eu/guides/nfsu2-unlock-vinyls-body-kits/): unlock visual parts for every car without skipping races
